rationale: Large strict-FP64 local meta-GGA density panels may reuse the existing bounded indexed typed-Dgemm recipe on architecture >=8 with positive single/double throughput ratio <=2. Work admission requires >=512 AOs, >=2^19 points and >=4 density-product jets. A public resource ledger, explicit reference budget, any lower-precision schedule, insufficient optional capacity or provider/cache allocation refusal retains generated execution. The additional allowance is capped at 128 MiB and accounts separately for the 96 MiB provider allowance, exact spin-matrix cache and retained host metadata. Unset/1 requests the qualified default; 0 rolls it back and 1 cannot bypass admission. Original symmetric-D, maps, grid, occupied witness, strict handoff, convergence and analytic-force semantics remain unchanged. Independent CPU bilinear and complete source-matched dual-GPU r2SCAN-3c cold/warm evidence qualify the scoped policy, not every eligible workload.
revisit_condition: Extend complete-endpoint qualification to other FP64-matrix devices and eligible workloads before claiming universal profitability. Preserve independent numerical gates, explicit opt-out and bounded resource fallback; do not replace the capability/work admission with product-name or molecule-name rules.
